reviewer: Supervising coding assistant; second software/evidence review, not independent domain-expert or blinded scientific validation
scope: Twelve archived v6 selections against complete captured abstracts; no new model request or changes to frozen labels

roles.reason: The sentence identifies this work's proposed algorithm, serving as its aim/contribution.
The selected sentence explicitly describes benchmarking against differential-equation solutions.
The selected benchmarking/finding sentence identifies no actual dataset or sampled population.
The numerical experiment reports effects of moving boundaries with its original qualification.
A background statement about cellular dynamics does not state a limitation of this study.
The qualified implication of the numerical experiment is an author takeaway.
The null finding is a result, not the explicit purpose stated earlier in the abstract.
The null finding does not describe the randomized experimental design.
The null finding does not identify the 1,544 papers and 2,797 reviewers described in the design sentence.
The quote reports the study's null result without changing its wording.
The quoted policy implication is not an explicit limitation of this study or inference.
The quote explicitly states a qualified policy implication.

summary.limits: Tiny already-inspected sample. Reviewer saw original labels/outcomes; this is confirmation of concrete errors, not a new independent accuracy estimate. No full-text or scientific-truth assessment.
